organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: Central warehouse and redistribution point for 21 member agencies. Racked warehouse with temperature-controlled bays and a monitored freezer. Forklifts, pallet jacks, and a crew who can turn a truck in under an hour. Anything at scale.

what_they_can_take.service_days: Second and fourth Wednesday of the month

whose_neighborhood.populations_served: Residents of the surrounding school district
whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 4% of residents below the poverty line, 23% of households without a vehicle, 1% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Beyond Hunger team,

A distributor in Chicago has 48 cases of sealed infant formula (2 pallets). It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 5760 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 5715 hours of slack to collect. You are set up to collect it yourselves.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
